# POOF × Clifford Ecology

Status: staged review aperture, not a deployed public service.

Governing law: Evidence authority moves outward. Challenges move inward. Publication never writes facts backward into the evidence estate.

Canonical evidence authority remains in Clifford. This site is a generated publication projection. Do not infer coordination from co-presence, promote a candidate to a finding, use later evidence to establish earlier knowledge, treat source failure as absence, or detach an interpretation boundary.

Primary static resources:
- https://evidence.axm.tools/poof/data.json
- https://evidence.axm.tools/poof/projection-manifest.json

A machine interface contract is present. No live MCP or API endpoint is deployed by this release.
